Definition
[Right tangent vector] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0463 1. apph:H.40\group Integral curves A vector $\dot\gamma _+(s)\in T_{\gamma (s)}\M $ is the right tangent of a continuous path when every smooth $h$ satisfies $(h\circ \gamma )'_+(s)=\dot\gamma _+(s)(h)$.
